Callout.Name: Fire at a Scrapyard
Callout.Message: Fire at a scrapyard, dense smoke.
Callout.Advisory: No persons on site, wind taking smoke over houses.

Script.Line: There is nobody on site. The gates are locked.
There are cars stacked three high and there is fuel in all of them.
The smoke is going over the houses. That is what I would worry about.

Lines.Approach: The smoke is going straight over the houses and there are cars stacked in there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
